mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_activity_feedback (activity_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, score, content) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{score}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, score, content, created_at FROM meal_activity_feedback WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
